# Pickly

> Pickly is a product review and comparison site. Every recommendation goes through a real evaluation process: products are bought or borrowed and tested in actual use, ranked against explicit criteria (durability, value, comfort), with full affiliate disclosure. 578+ reviews across 10 categories, published in 17 languages.

Reviews follow a consistent structure: a ranked comparison of ~5 products with test-based verdicts, spec tables, per-criterion scores, pros/cons, FAQs, and buying guidance. English is the primary edition; localized editions exist at /{locale}/ (ja, de, es, fr, it, ru, pt-BR and more).
